description: Defines the SingleComparisonNode class, which models a comparison node such as EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, LE, and LIKE in an abstract syntax tree for RQL predicates. It includes type enumeration and visitor acceptance logic.

classes.name: SingleComparisonNode
classes.description: Represents a comparison (e.g., eq, ne, gt) in an abstract syntax tree node for RQL predicate expressions.

classes.name: SingleComparisonNode.Type
classes.description: Enumerates the comparison types supported by SingleComparisonNode: EQ, NE, GT, GE, LT, LE, LIKE.

methods.name: SingleComparisonNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the comparison node with a type, property, and value.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and calls its visit method with this node.
